briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Every item below is from the search results provided. I found no hiring news in that window.

## Restructuring and layoffs

- Canva announced a restructure affecting 22% of its global workforce. CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that the company needs to "re-found Canva" around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- The job cuts affect 1,271 employees (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- The reorganisation flattens the org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html). Reports say product, growth and platform teams are being merged, and the company wants to reduce "subspecialisation" so remaining staff take on broader roles (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary plus other support (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304). The package also includes company-issued MacBooks, a free year of LinkedIn Premium and career coaching (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms). Those leaving can also apply for $US10,000 grants to start a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Before the announcement, a Capital Brief report said Canva could cut more jobs or freeze hiring in November. Canva had not confirmed this (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported 32 finance-division roles cut in January, previously unreported (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## AI and partnerships

- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The two companies will work on making these models cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. This came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## Marketing

- Canva launched a new North America brand platform, "What Will You Canva Today?", by agency Goodby's. It opened with three comedy TV spots, the first airing during NBC Sunday Night Football (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

## Unverified deal

- A wire report says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion" and expects the deal to close next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The item does not name Canva.** Treat it as unconfirmed for this meeting until the target is verified.

## Open questions

1. Will the restructure be followed by further cuts or a hiring freeze, and how will the merged product, growth and platform teams be staffed?
2. Is Canva the target in the reported $9.4 billion Globex deal? If so, what does it mean for the roadmap, partners and the timing of the close?
3. How will the expanded OpenAI partnership and the new in-house models be prioritised after the reorganisation, and what cost savings are expected?
